2609.04959.title: Discourse Dependency: A Continuous Criterion for Translation Difficulty
2609.04959.paper_summary: Recent calls for harder machine translation benchmarks have not clarified what difficulty should mean. We argue that one meaningful and currently unmeasured axis is referential reach, the distance a segment must look back into its document to resolve the entities and pronouns it contains. We formalize this as discourse dependency (DDP), a metric-free, source-side measure computed from named entity re-mentions and pronominal coreference. Validated against gold coreference, DDP errs one-sidedly in 99.2% of segments, so a high-DDP segment is certified to require long-range context. Applying DDP to WMT24++ and WMT25 shows that both are heavily skewed toward low-DDP segments, which domain labels do not distinguish. Building on DDP, we compare five context injection strategies in an English-Korean post-editing setup, varying context size and selection. As DDP grows, no strategy keeps pace with human post-editing. On segments with DDP >= 15 raters prefer human translations, while automatic metrics register no difference. As frontier systems saturate aggregate scores, DDP shifts evaluation from how well models score to how far they can reach.
2609.04959.paper_summary_zh: 近期對更嚴格機器翻譯基準的呼籲並未明確定義困難應該意味著什麼。<lb/>我們認為，一個有意義且目前未被測量的軸心是參照範圍，即一個片段必須回溯到其文件中的多遠，以解決其所包含的實體和代詞。<lb/>我們將其形式化為話語依賴性（DDP），這是一種無度量的、源端的度量，通過命名實體的重提和代詞的共指來計算。<lb/>根據金標準的共指進行驗證，DDP 在 99.2% 的片段中出現單邊錯誤，因此高 DDP 片段被認證為需要長距離上下文。<lb/>將 DDP 應用於 WMT24++ 和 WMT25 顯示，兩者都嚴重偏向低 DDP 片段，而領域標籤並未區分這些片段。<lb/>基於 DDP，我們在英韓後編輯設置中比較了五種上下文注入策略，變化上下文大小和選擇。<lb/>隨著 DDP 的增長，沒有任何策略能與人類後編輯保持同步。<lb/>在 DDP >= 15 的片段中，評審更偏好人類翻譯，而自動度量則未顯示任何差異。<lb/>隨著前沿系統飽和總分，DDP 將評估從模型得分的優劣轉移到它們能夠達到的範圍。
